scope: The surviving upper adobe citadel of Naryn Castle in Meybod as seen in 2009, including the eroded mound and curtain, the round decorated tower, and the raised keep and terrace within the named mapped structure.

originalReview.notes: The view shows a sandy adobe enclosure built into the eroded mound, a rounded corner bastion, the tall round tower with several bands of diamond and diagonal adobe patterns, and the high rectangular keep behind it.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the only Commons file upload. Betta27 is the named author, original uploader and author of the own-work public-domain dedication. The native date is recorded as 02/04/2009; the preview uses year precision.
